Manifest.Name: Authenticated CLIs
Manifest.Description: Use your signed-in Codex, Claude Code and OpenCode CLIs as LLM providers
Settings.InstallHelp: Install or sign in from a terminal, then run Validate to check the status again.
Settings.OpenCodeCatalogPending: The free-model catalog has not been refreshed yet.
Settings.OpenCodeCatalogCached: Catalog refresh failed. The last verified free-model list remains visible.
Settings.OpenCodeCatalogFailed: The current free-model catalog could not be loaded. Refresh after checking your connection.
Settings.OpenCodeFreeOnly: Only models currently reported as fully free by OpenCode Zen are exposed. Free offers can change or end at any time.
Settings.OpenCodePrivacyWarning: Privacy warning: Some free Zen models may allow prompts and completions to be used for training. Do not send personal or confidential data unless the selected model's terms allow it.
State.SelectedExecutableMissing: The selected installation is no longer available. Select another one.
State.UnsupportedExecutableType: Only a regular executable file on PATH is supported.
State.UnsupportedVersion: Installed version does not support the required safety controls.
State.AuthenticationUnknown: Login status cannot be checked safely
State.ModelCatalogUnavailable: Signed in, but the current free Zen model catalog could not be loaded
State.NoFreeModels: No fully free OpenCode Zen text models are currently available

Settings.ProfilesDescription: Add another signed-in session of a CLI, for example a second account. Each profile appears as its own provider in workflows. Run Validate to check every profile again.
Settings.ProfileExecutableDescription: Choose an installation of the selected CLI, or Automatic to use the only one found on PATH.
Settings.ProfileEnvironmentDescription: One NAME=VALUE per line, each an existing absolute directory: CODEX_HOME for Codex, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR for Claude Code, XDG_DATA_HOME for OpenCode. Leave empty to use the CLI's normal session. Sign in to that session from a terminal first.
Settings.ProfilesSaved: Saved {0} CLI profile(s). Their status is being checked.
